notes:
Summary: Mid-market product org building an in-app assistant + knowledge search for customer success and onboarding. Started with Hosted API quickstart (2-week POC) to validate model quality for support flows; now negotiating Dedicated reserved capacity to control unit economics and ensure consistent latency for live users.

POC highlights: hosted POC (2/15–2/28) integrated with product sandbox via SDK. Achieved quality bar on intent classification + summarization. Key quote from CTO (Nikhil Rao): "We need predictable TCO for a 6–12 month rollout — hosted rates look fine for prototyping but won't scale economically."

Performance targets: target p95 token latency <= 250ms for short-turn chat (avg 150–250 tokens). Target steady-state throughput: 20–30 requests/sec (avg response ~400 tokens), peak burst allowance to 120 requests/sec during onboarding surges. Embedding pipeline: hourly bulk embed jobs (10k docs/hour) with lower latency sensitivity.

Pricing & packaging discussion (current): exploring 3-tier commit proposal from Redwood Dedicated: 1) Base commit level: 250k tokens/day reserved (monthly true-up); 2) Burst buffer: up to 5x base (1.25M tokens/day) billed at burst tier; 3) Overage: 1.5x committed rate for sustained overage beyond burst in a given billing month, with collar & monthly true-up. WillowGate asked for a cap on overage spend (not to exceed 120% of committed spend/month) and a 6-month ramp schedule (month1 50% commit utilization guaranteed, month2 70%, month3 85%, month4+ steady). Redwood SE proposed auto-burst throttles + alerting.

Commercial asks from WillowGate: want a 12-month reserved term with quarterly ramp milestones, a 20–30% discount off hosted list when committed, and included 10% burst at no extra charge for first 90 days of GA to support onboarding. Also asked for credit for unused committed tokens (rolling credit for 3 months).

Security/compliance: WillowGate requires SOC2 (in scope), SSO/SAML for Console access, audit logging sent to their SIEM, and option for EU data residency for EU customers. Legal has opened security questionnaire (see linked doc).

POC artifacts: integration code snippets pushed to their sandbox repo, latency/throughput results spreadsheet (drive link), sample eval prompts used for regression checks.

Sales notes / relationship: AE Maya ran initial discovery (1/30). SE Carlos ran two technical demos (2/8, 3/3). Product team (PM + infra lead) attended dedicated demo 3/3. Procurement now driving final commercial terms.

Decision drivers: predictable monthly cost, guaranteed p95 latency SLAs for live product, reasonable burst for onboarding, EU residency option, clear overage cap.

Next steps (short): 1) Redwood to provide final term sheet with explicit overage cap and ramp schedule (target 3/15). 2) Legal exchange DPA + SCCs (WillowGate legal to review; Redwood to provide redline template). 3) Schedule infra onboarding deep-dive w/ networking runbook (target week of 3/22).
